scenarios.given: plugin is initialized with config.setup({})
scenarios.then: returns a fully-populated table with mode='auto', threshold_chars=12000, chunk_chars=6000, max_chunks_per_file=6, small_file_chars=800, max_small_files_inline=10, small_file_batch_chars=4000, summary_model=nil, summary_max_tokens=220, summary_temperature=0.2, concurrency=4
scenarios.notes: Covers M.defaults large_diff block; already exercised by the 'provides default large_diff block' test.

scenarios.given: config.setup({ large_diff = { mode = 'always', concurrency = 2 } })
scenarios.then: mode returns 'always', concurrency returns 2, threshold_chars still returns 12000 (default survives deep merge)
scenarios.notes: Validates deep-merge correctness for large_diff block.

scenarios.given: config.setup({ large_diff = { mode = 'off' } })
scenarios.then: returns true with zero errors

scenarios.given: config.setup({ large_diff = { mode = 'auto' } })
scenarios.then: returns true with zero errors

scenarios.given: config.setup({ large_diff = { mode = 'always' } })
scenarios.then: returns true with zero errors

scenarios.given: config.setup({ large_diff = { mode = 'banana' } })
scenarios.then: returns false; errors[1] contains the string 'large_diff.mode'
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'rejects unknown mode' test.

scenarios.given: large_diff.mode = 'off', diff of any size
scenarios.then: input/default.lua prepare is invoked; input/rich.lua prepare is never called; callback receives raw diff string
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'routes to default when mode is off' test.

scenarios.given: large_diff.mode = 'auto', threshold_chars = 100, staged diff has 50 chars
scenarios.then: input/default.lua prepare is invoked; rich path is not taken
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'routes to default when mode is auto and diff is below threshold'.

scenarios.given: large_diff.mode = 'auto', threshold_chars = 10, staged diff has 50 chars
scenarios.then: input/rich.lua prepare is invoked; default path is not taken
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'routes to rich when mode is auto and diff exceeds threshold'.

scenarios.given: large_diff.mode = 'always', diff has only 1 char (far below any threshold)
scenarios.then: input/rich.lua prepare is invoked regardless of diff size
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'routes to rich when mode is always'.

scenarios.given: rich.split_diff_by_file is called with an empty string
scenarios.then: returns an empty table {}
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: a two-file unified diff string with 'diff --git a/foo b/foo' and 'diff --git a/bar b/bar' boundaries
scenarios.then: returns a table of 2 entries; entry[1].path = 'foo.lua', entry[2].path = 'bar.lua'; each entry contains the correct diff text

scenarios.given: a diff string containing 'Binary files a/img.png and b/img.png differ'
scenarios.then: returns 1 entry with is_binary = true

scenarios.given: a file diff with two small hunks whose combined size is below chunk_chars
scenarios.then: returns 1 chunk containing both hunks

scenarios.given: a file diff with two hunks each ~60 chars; chunk_chars = 80 (fits one but not two)
scenarios.then: returns 2 chunks; each chunk starts with '@@'

scenarios.given: a file diff with one hunk larger than chunk_chars
scenarios.then: returns exactly 1 chunk containing the entire oversized hunk; hunk is not split mid-hunk

scenarios.given: one file whose diff length > small_file_chars
scenarios.then: file is placed in buckets.large; small_inline and small_batched are empty

scenarios.given: 2 files each with diff <= small_file_chars; max_small_files_inline = 2
scenarios.then: both files are in buckets.small_inline; small_batched is empty

scenarios.given: 3 files each with diff <= small_file_chars; max_small_files_inline = 2
scenarios.then: all 3 files are in buckets.small_batched; small_inline is empty
scenarios.notes: Decision is made once per invocation; no cross-bucket mixing.

scenarios.given: one file with is_binary = true
scenarios.then: file is placed in buckets.stat_only; it does not appear in large, small_inline, or small_batched

scenarios.given: a file whose diff has zero hunks (mode-only change, no '@@ ... @@' lines)
scenarios.when: rich.bucket_files or the large-file path runs
scenarios.then: file is treated as stat-only and bypasses both summarization paths
scenarios.notes: Spec: 'files with zero hunks are always treated as stat-only entries'.

scenarios.given: large_diff.max_chunks_per_file = 2; a large file that produces 3 chunks after splitting
scenarios.then: no summary calls are made for that file; final payload contains a stat-only entry for that file with the note '(diff omitted: exceeded max_chunks_per_file)'
scenarios.notes: Overflow check is step 2 of the large-file path.

scenarios.given: one large file that produces 2 chunks (within max_chunks_per_file); mock provider returns a summary string for each call
scenarios.then: callback fires with err=nil; payload is a string containing the file path and the mock summary text; no stat-only note is present for that file
scenarios.notes: Happy path: per-chunk summary -> file roll-up -> assembled payload.

scenarios.given: 3 small files (count > max_small_files_inline=2); mock provider returns batch summary text
scenarios.then: callback fires with err=nil; payload contains the mock batch summary text
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'small-batched path produces a payload containing batch summary'.

scenarios.given: 3 small files; first two files together fit within small_file_batch_chars; adding the third would exceed it
scenarios.then: two batches are created: one with the first two files, one with the third file; provider.summarize is called twice
scenarios.notes: Boundary condition for batch packing algorithm.

scenarios.given: one large file; first chunk summary call returns an error
scenarios.then: remaining chunk calls for that file are cancelled; final payload contains a stat-only entry for that file; pipeline does not abort; callback err is nil
scenarios.notes: Partial failure: single-file degradation.

scenarios.given: one large file; per-chunk summaries succeed but file roll-up call returns an error
scenarios.then: final payload contains a stat-only entry for that file; callback err is nil

scenarios.given: 3 small-batched files forming one batch; batch summary call returns an error
scenarios.then: all 3 files in the failed batch fall back to stat-only entries; pipeline does not abort; callback err is nil

scenarios.given: 3 large files; files 1 and 2 summarize successfully; file 3 summary call fails
scenarios.then: callback fires with err=nil; payload contains roll-up summaries for files 1 and 2 plus a stat-only entry for file 3
scenarios.notes: Mixed payload scenario; pipeline is not aborted.

scenarios.given: one large file; all summary calls (chunk and roll-up) return errors; no small-inline files exist
scenarios.then: callback fires with a non-nil error string; generate_commit_message is not called
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'falls back to stat-only when all summaries fail'. Condition: zero summaries succeeded.

scenarios.given: 2 small-inline files (count <= max_small_files_inline); no large or small-batched files
scenarios.then: no provider.summarize calls are made; callback fires with err=nil; payload contains raw diffs for both files
scenarios.notes: Spec: 'all-failed abort applies only when at least one summary call was attempted; if all files are small-inline there are zero summary calls and this condition does not trigger'.

scenarios.given: make_scheduler(2) is called; one task is enqueued
scenarios.when: the task runs and calls done()
scenarios.then: the task's body executes and its done callback is called
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'runs a single task and calls its done callback'.

scenarios.given: make_scheduler(2) is called; 4 tasks are enqueued; each task holds the slot until done() is explicitly called
scenarios.then: the peak number of simultaneously in-flight tasks never exceeds 2
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'respects concurrency cap' test.

scenarios.given: make_scheduler(1) is called; 3 tasks enqueued
scenarios.then: all 3 tasks execute to completion; none are dropped

scenarios.given: vim.fn.system is stubbed to return a valid stat string with shell_error = 0
scenarios.then: callback fires with err=nil and a non-empty stat string
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: vim.fn.system is stubbed to return empty string with shell_error = 1
scenarios.then: callback fires with a non-nil error string containing 'stat' (case-insensitive)
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: git.get_staged_stat is called
scenarios.then: callback has already been invoked in the same call frame (no vim.schedule wrapping)
scenarios.notes: Spec: 'calls vim.fn.system synchronously and invokes the callback in the same call frame'.

scenarios.given: git.get_staged_stat is stubbed to return an error
scenarios.then: callback fires immediately with a non-nil error string; no provider.summarize calls are made
scenarios.notes: Spec: 'git diff --cached --stat fails → abort with error; stat block is load-bearing'.

scenarios.given: rich pipeline runs successfully; git.get_staged_stat returns ' big.lua | 10 +++\n 1 file changed'
scenarios.then: payload string contains the stat block text ('file changed' or the stat line)
scenarios.notes: Overall stat block is always included per spec.

scenarios.given: one large file 'big.lua' summarizes successfully
scenarios.then: payload contains '### big.lua' header followed by the roll-up summary text

scenarios.given: one small-inline file 'small.lua' with raw diff content '+added line'
scenarios.then: payload contains '### small.lua' header followed by the raw diff verbatim

scenarios.given: a file demoted to stat-only due to overflow (exceeded max_chunks_per_file)
scenarios.then: payload contains '### <path>' header followed by its stat line and the text '(diff omitted: exceeded max_chunks_per_file)'

scenarios.given: prompts.build_summary_prompt('chunk', payload, { file_path = 'src/mod.lua' }) is called
scenarios.then: result is a table with string fields 'system' and 'user'; system contains 'summarizer'; user contains 'src/mod.lua' and payload content
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: prompts.build_summary_prompt('file_rollup', chunk_summaries, { file_path = 'a.lua' }) is called
scenarios.then: system contains 'paragraph'; user contains 'a.lua' and 'Chunk summaries'
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: prompts.build_summary_prompt('small_batch', batch_payload, {}) is called; batch_payload contains 'file1.lua'
scenarios.then: system contains 'bullet per file'; user contains 'file1.lua'
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: prompts.build_summary_prompt('unknown', '', {}) is called
scenarios.then: an error is raised
scenarios.notes: Already covered.

scenarios.given: input.prepare is stubbed to return 'TRANSFORMED_PAYLOAD'; provider.generate_commit_message is stubbed to record its first argument
scenarios.then: provider.generate_commit_message receives 'TRANSFORMED_PAYLOAD' as its diff argument
scenarios.notes: Already covered by 'calls generate_commit_message with final_payload from input.prepare'.

scenarios.given: husky detection is enabled; a commitlint config exists
scenarios.then: provider_config passed to input.prepare already contains the commitlint injection (same table later passed to generate_commit_message); summary calls inside rich.lua do NOT receive commitlint rules
scenarios.notes: Spec: 'husky injection runs before input.prepare; summary calls do not receive commitlint rules'.

scenarios.given: picker.show_status is stubbed to record calls; rich.prepare is invoked
scenarios.then: picker.show_status is called with 'Analyzing staged diff...'

scenarios.given: picker.show_status is stubbed; 2 large files + 1 batch of small-batched files
scenarios.when: per-chunk and small-batch summary phase begins
scenarios.then: picker.show_status is called with a string containing 'Summarizing' and the number 3 (2 large + 1 batch group)
scenarios.notes: N = count of large files + count of small-batched files.

scenarios.given: picker.show_status is stubbed; at least one large file succeeds summarization
scenarios.then: picker.show_status is called with 'Composing file summaries...'

scenarios.given: picker.close_status is stubbed; rich pipeline completes successfully
scenarios.then: picker.close_status was called before the callback

scenarios.given: picker.close_status is stubbed; all summary calls fail triggering abort
scenarios.when: rich.prepare callback fires with non-nil error
scenarios.then: picker.close_status was called before the callback (window does not remain open)

scenarios.given: all files are small-inline (zero summary calls needed)
scenarios.then: picker.show_status is NOT called with a string starting 'Summarizing'
scenarios.notes: Spec: total_tasks == 0 case.

scenarios.given: any concrete provider module is loaded (e.g. openai)
scenarios.then: provider.summarize is a function
scenarios.notes: New method added to every provider.

scenarios.given: a mock provider.summarize implementation; provider_config contains api_key = 'test-key'
scenarios.when: provider.summarize is called via rich pipeline
scenarios.then: the api_key from provider_config is accessible inside summarize (same table as generate_commit_message receives)
scenarios.notes: Spec: 'provider_config is passed explicitly so providers can access auth credentials'.

scenarios.given: input/default.lua prepare is called with diff_data.diff = 'raw-diff'
scenarios.then: callback receives err=nil and payload = 'raw-diff' (unmodified raw diff string)
